title: Greef Karga
description: Greef Karga was once an expeditor for the Bounty Hunters Guild on Nevarro, connecting clients and bounty hunters as an efficient middleman. Slowly, he worked his way up to become the Magistrate of Nevarro, cleaning up the Outer Rim world by driving off pirates, Imperials, and other ne'er-do-wells who had made it such a rough-and-tumble place.
